Pick the most expressed reference transcript for a gene

Source: R/utils.R
pick_canonical_tx.Rd

Selects the highest-expressed reference transcript for a given gene from a `SummarizedExperiment` object generated by `stringtieCombine()`.

Usage

pick_canonical_tx(
  combineSE,
  gene,
  assay_name = "FPKM",
  samples = NULL,
  ref_tx_pattern = "^ENS"
)

Arguments

combineSE

A `SummarizedExperiment` object generated by `stringtieCombine()`.

gene

Character. Gene name to query.

assay_name

Character. Assay used for ranking. Default is `"FPKM"`.

samples

Optional character or integer vector. Samples/columns used for expression ranking. If `NULL`, all columns are used.

ref_tx_pattern

Optional regular expression used to restrict reference transcript IDs. Default is `"^ENS"`. Set to `NULL` to disable this filter.

Value

A character scalar transcript ID. Returns `NA_character_` if no match is found.
